subject.title: fix(crestodian): keep onboarding connected through restart

question: Should the restart-response, deterministic handoff, and profile-isolation fixes be extracted from the broader inference-first/Codex/plugin-runtime rewrite, or should the entire branch ship as one release unit?
rationale: The branch combines urgent, well-proven fixes with large product, plugin-contract, auth-binding, and onboarding changes; automation cannot determine whether that coupling and release blast radius reflect intended product direction.

options.title: Extract focused fixes
options.body: Land the three urgent fixes in narrow patches and review the wider onboarding and runtime-contract redesign separately.

options.title: Keep one release unit
options.body: Retain the unified branch only after explicit owner acceptance and complete exact-head security, compatibility, upgrade, dependency, and platform proof.

options.title: Pause the redesign
options.body: Keep the linked bugs open while maintainers reconsider the broader inference-first and plugin-runtime direction.

recommendation.title: Extract focused fixes
recommendation.body: Land the three urgent fixes in narrow patches and review the wider onboarding and runtime-contract redesign separately.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the central feature history, authored the cross-surface design, and is assigned to the PR.
